blocks.heading: Built For Belt And Placket Lines That Can't Afford Width Variance
blocks.html:
Belt roll & placket (patti) is a firm-bodied interlining fabric that we cut and roll to specific widths before it ever reaches your cutting table. Where general-purpose interlining is sold as bulk yardage and cut down at the buyer's end, this category arrives pre-sized — so every metre that comes off the roll matches the width your belt or placket design calls for.

That width consistency matters more on a belt or placket line than almost anywhere else in garment production. A soft fabric belt gets its shape entirely from the interlining inside it, and a trouser or shirt placket needs the same firm, even strip behind it to sit flat and stitch straight. If the roll width drifts even a few millimetres across a batch, the finished belts and plackets drift with it — and a procurement team ends up sorting rejects instead of shipping.

We manufacture belt roll & placket (patti) for fabric belts, waist ties, sash belts, uniform belts and trouser or shirt plackets, supplying garment units and buying houses that run belt and placket assembly as a dedicated production line, not a side task.

blocks.heading: Belt Roll & Placket (Patti) FAQs
blocks.intro: Have a question specific to your belt or placket design, or order size? Ask us directly.

items.q: What belt widths do you stock as standard?
items.a: We keep a set of standard roll widths that cover the most common fabric belt, waist tie and uniform belt designs. Share your belt design or target width and we'll confirm the closest standard match.

items.q: Can you cut custom widths for our belt design?
items.a: Yes. On confirmed bulk orders we cut and roll belt interlining to the exact width your belt design calls for. Send your specification and we'll confirm feasibility and lead time.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity for belt roll & placket (patti)?
items.a: Minimum quantities depend on the width and whether it's a standard or custom cut. Share your requirement through our contact form and we'll confirm a feasible order size for your specification.

items.q: Do you supply pre-cut lengths or only full rolls?
items.a: Belt roll is supplied as full rolls by default. For larger bulk orders we can also discuss cut-length options — raise this with our team when you share your order quantity.

blocks.heading: Need Belt Roll & Placket (Patti) Cut To Your Exact Width?
blocks.text: Send us your belt or placket design and target width — we'll confirm the closest standard match or a custom cut, along with pricing and lead time. See our manufacturing process for how we hold width consistency across every roll.
